recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, nocturnal landscape featuring multiple glowing, ghostly projections of a man in a trench coat and fedora, receding into the distance. The scene is topped with a dynamic, slanted script logo that glows against the dark sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale progression of figures creating depth
High contrast between glowing subjects and deep black background
Dynamic diagonal tension between the top-aligned script and the bottom-aligned figures
Ethereal glow vs. sharp silhouette of the treeline

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures arranged along a receding diagonal from bottom-left to mid-right; largest figure is foregrounded on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The largest glowing figure in the bottom-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large figure, follows the line of smaller figures into the distance, then jumps to the bright script at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black space in the center and upper-right, emphasizing the isolation of the glowing elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool white with cyan tint (glowing figures)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast; zero saturation in the background with high-value highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a heavy rightward slant
letterConstructionRules: Long horizontal underline extending from the final character
Variable stroke width mimicking a brush or calligraphy pen
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'Q' with a large, sweeping loop
Lowercase 'f' with a long, sharp descender that integrates into the underline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant script against a photographic background.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 80s energy and sharp brush strokes.
Matches the fluid, connected nature of the lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A dark nocturnal field at night. In the background, a silhouette of a treeline against a slightly lighter dark sky. In the foreground and middle ground, four glowing, semi-transparent projections of a man wearing a 1940s style trench coat and fedora. The figures should decrease in size as they move toward the right, creating a sense of depth. The figures should have a soft cyan-white glow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white, calligraphic script logo at the top center. The text should have a sharp upward slant to the right and a long horizontal underline that starts from the middle of the word and extends to the right.

verificationChecks: Figures must appear as light projections, not solid people
Typography must have a distinct upward diagonal slant
Background must be predominantly black with minimal detail
The underline must be a sharp, straight vector line

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures
Specific letterforms of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Is the largest figure on the left?
Do the figures have a ghostly glow?
recipe.reuseFormula: Nocturnal landscape + receding glowing projections + slanted calligraphic script overlay.
